comment: PEDAL BUILD manifest for Horizon (9-knob). A huge, spacey reverb: pre-delay, four diffusers, an 8-line modulated feedback delay network up to cathedral sizes, decays from about a second to a minute and a hold at the top, damping inside the loop, a swell that blooms each note in, stereo width. All knobs 0..100.
fxid_comment: 0x01A3. In this project's reserved 403-499 Delay block; free in every group's DB entry. Check repeat98's FXID registry before release.

params.name: Size
params.comment: params[5]. The space, a room to a cathedral (the delay lines x0.35 .. x1.52); turning it bends the pitch of the tail.

params.name: Decay
params.comment: params[6]. Reverb time, about 0.8 s to a minute; 100 holds the tail forever and stops taking new sound.

params.name: Mod
params.comment: params[8]. Slow movement of the delay lines: chorus in the tail, shimmer at the top.

params.name: Lo
params.comment: params[9]. Low cut inside the tail, 20 .. 600 Hz.

params.name: Hi
params.comment: params[10]. High cut inside the tail, 1.5 .. 16 kHz: dark to bright.

params.name: Swell
params.comment: params[11]. Each note blooms into the reverb, over up to 2 s; 0 off.

params.name: Width
params.comment: params[12]. Stereo width of the tail, mono .. extra wide.
